name: Jamie Osei
background: Former Regional VP of Operations at CAVA, where he oversaw expansion from 40 to 120 locations over five years. Before CAVA, spent four years as a General Manager at Sweetgreen, opening six locations from scratch. Deep experience in site selection, franchise partner management, supply chain, and food quality control at scale. Now launching FreshRoots Kitchen, his own fast-casual concept. First time as a founder but a thirty-year veteran of restaurant operations.
personality: Calm, unhurried, speaks in operational specifics. Answers every question with a concrete example from his own experience. Does not oversell -- lets the track record speak. Occasionally self-deprecating about not being a 'typical startup founder' but entirely confident about the operational dimension. Gets animated when discussing unit economics and site selection.
motivation: Has spent his career executing other people's concepts. Believes he now understands the fast-casual playbook better than almost anyone alive, and wants to prove it with his own name on the door. Sees a gap in mid-size cities that the coastal chains have ignored.

capital.embodied_detail: Thirty years of hands-on restaurant operations. Has personally opened over twenty locations across two major chains. Knows the unit economics of fast-casual better than most founders in the space -- not from a model but from lived experience.
capital.objectified_detail: Signed LOIs with two mid-size city landlords. Prototype menu tested with a pop-up generating $180K revenue over six months. Full financial model built from actual CAVA and Sweetgreen cost structures he operated within.
capital.institutional_detail: CAVA and Sweetgreen on the resume are immediately legible signals to any consumer-operations investor. No Wharton MBA, but his operational pedigree is the equivalent in this domain.
capital.social_detail: Strong network in the restaurant and consumer retail industry. Relationships with commercial real estate brokers in target cities. Warm introductions to several consumer-focused VCs through former CAVA colleagues.
capital.symbolic_detail: Immediately credible as the person to execute this story. An operations-focused investor will recognize the pattern: he has done this before, at scale, for someone else. The question is whether the concept itself is differentiated enough.
